content.rationale: Load is where S2-validate's checking point, S2-invalid's reason-attached failure, D1c's document, and D1d's schema meet; this check drives conforming, missing, malformed, and schema-violating documents through the gate. It needs serde_json and the schema validator, so it is a crate of its own. I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the crate is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive, and I1-schema (`zmmyomyp`) fixes the validator these documents are checked with. It also pins the checking point on text (S2-validate-once, rnxnqzxn): `check` answers conforming, malformed and schema-violating text, and two checks in one process exercise the once-compiled schema.
